name: run_diagnostic_step
description: Run one diagnostic step directly against the backend -- no session, no start call needed. Call get_diagnostics_prompt first to see the available steps and how to reason about them (get_full_system_config/get_core_services_status/get_device_family are NOT in this catalog -- they're their own standing tools, call them directly instead). Most steps are independent reads and can be called together in the same turn; the exception is get_dev_links_table/compare_device_links/get_all_plm_links/quick_plm_sanity_check, which drive the single PLM serial connection directly and must be called one at a time -- see get_diagnostics_prompt for the exact rule.

step.description: The exact step name from get_diagnostics_prompt's step catalog (e.g. "quick_plm_sanity_check", "compare_device_links", "services_ops"). Prefer the higher-level steps -- they already combine and interpret the underlying data. Never invented.

params.description: Parameters the step needs, e.g. {"device_id": "..."} for compare_device_links/get_dev_links_table/get_iox_links_table, {"op": "restart", "service": "..."} for services_ops. Omit or leave empty for steps that need nothing, like quick_plm_sanity_check or get_all_plm_links.
